budget_accounting: Frozen Phase21/20D pool costs include snapshot read, EDT/cache, IPC and solve. P2/P3 add cache transfer and refinement to P0 time;1s end-to-end, overruns rejected. Rollout evaluation excluded from planner time.

rollout.oracle: passive swept evaluation; does not affect command generation or terminate the path
rollout.missing_time: No completion time when incomplete; no imputation

dataset.source: same Phase21 tuning manifest; all final Phase21 B4/M3 ALL_UNSAFE first-stage A plus NO_PROGRESS B snapshots; no optional additional methods
dataset.duplicate_policy: Do not also count A-trigger R3 fallback boundary

p3: one open Chaikin pass blended with arclength-resampled P0; fixed endpoints; strength halved for3 retries after initial attempt; depth/geometry failure then exact P0 fallback
p2: single P0 arclength-resampled11-point initialization; unchanged R3 factors/constraints/SLSQP100/ftol1e-8; analytic added factors; exact nearest-polyline distance tube<=.30m (not a mathematical homotopy proof)

comparison.safety: all snapshots, plan failure fraction and oracle geometric negative witness counts
comparison.side: P0 planned side defined at first forward front-face crossing; otherwise endpoint in a clear lateral gap. Undefined P0 side omitted from side denominator, undefined P2 counts mismatch; zero denominator fails criterion(ii)
comparison.median_subset: same snapshots where P0/P2/P3 all plan successfully and complete without oracle overlap; report N; zero subset fails(iii-v)
comparison.endpoint: planned last chord heading absolute error and planned endpoint distance to anchor/u_ref line; actual terminal pose errors also reported
comparison.wide_gap: unique larger gap only; equal-width gaps labelled TIE, not invented wide choices

tuning.p3: minimum collisions, plan failures, P0 side mismatches, jerk median, terminal heading+lateral, completion time; then smaller strength
tuning.p2: first prefer satisfying(i)&(ii), then most satisfied(iii-v), then fewer collisions/failures, lower sum of jerk/heading/lateral ratios to P0, shorter completion time, grid index; no evaluation inputs

decision.partial: i and ii and at least one of iii-v
decision.not_better: i or ii fail, or iii-v all fail
